reason: ADR 0038: design.god-class warns from matchedCount >= minCriteria and now reports that boundary instead of refusing. The old reader guessed property names and knew three; minCriteria was not one, so explain printed "not resolvable" for a boundary that is configurable, documented in GodClassRule's own docblock, and the very number withOverride writes the warning half into.

ADR 0038: design.data-class reports WOC downwards and emits while woc <= wocThreshold, so wocThreshold is its boundary and is now printed. wmcThreshold gates a second metric, exactly as minAfferent and minStatements gate elsewhere without stopping their classes from naming a boundary.
